name: SF_CLIENT_ID
label: Salesforce client ID
setupSteps: Create or reuse an External Client App in your Salesforce org for JWT bearer auth (each environment needs its own consumer key).
Copy the Consumer Key from the app and provide it here.

name: SF_USERNAME
label: Salesforce username
setupSteps: The integration user principal, e.g. remi@touchless.io. Must be allowed to authenticate via the client app's OAuth scopes.

name: SF_PRIVATE_KEY
label: Salesforce private key (PEM)
setupSteps: The RSA PKCS#8 private key whose public key / certificate is registered on the External Client App.
Paste the full PEM text including BEGIN/END PRIVATE KEY lines.
